question: Which of the following rivers is a tributary of Krishna River?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tungabhadra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The major tributaries of the Krishna River are:
 
• Left: Bhima, Dindi, Peddavagu, Musi, Paleru, Munneru.
 
• Right: Kudali (Niranjna) Venna, Koyna, Panchganga, Dudhaganga, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha, **Tungabhadra**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ​ **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Krishna River**

 
 
• It originates from the Western Ghats range near Mahabaleshwar in the state of Maharashtra.
 
• The Krishna River has a large and very fertile delta, which continues northeast towards the Godavari River region.
 
• The length of the Krishna river is about 1400 km.
 
• The Krishna River has the two largest tributaries, the Bhima (North) and the Tungabhadra (South).
 
• Koyna River is also a minor tributary of it on which Koyna Dam is situated.
